name: GISAT-1A (EOS-05)
location_str: Satish Dhawan Space Centre Second Launch Pad @ Satish Dhawan Space Centre, IND
slot_a_text: GISAT-1A (GEO Imaging Satellite) is an Indian earth observing satellite operating from geostationary orbit to facilitate continuous observation of Indian sub-continent, quick monitoring of natural hazards and disaster.  EOS-05/GISAT-1A will replace EOS-03/GISAT-1 lost in launch failure in 2021.
slot_b_text: Satish Dhawan Space Centre Second Launch Pad has supported 33 launches.
